title: Optimization of ultrasonic-assisted extraction of dietary fiber from bhimkol (Musa balbisiana) peel using central composite design: physicochemical, functional, and thermal properties
content:

Bhimkol is a seeded banana found in northeastern and southern India, and its peel is a good source of dietary fiber (DF) and can be utilized for various food applications.
